name: io.github.ashishsinha1602/schemagate
description: Identity-scoped schema selection for text-to-SQL: returns only the tables the calling user may read, before any SQL is generated. Any SQLAlchemy database.

environment_variables.name: SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the database to reflect, or 'demo' for the bundled schema

environment_variables.name: SCHEMAGATE_CATALOG_CONFIG
environment_variables.description: Optional path to a JSON file with roles, hints and shadow-name overrides
